method: each claim is checked STRUCTURALLY: does the evidence the guide demands exist, and is the lab making the claim at all. A lexical scan cannot tell a claim from a denial of one -- two earlier attempts in this lab flagged a requirement's own title, then its own negation

checks.would_need: an out-of-fold contribution, not an in-sample correlation
checks.note: the ablation FAILED -- variance resolved out of fold went +0.335 -> +0.095 -> -0.036 as blocks were added -- and the lab reports that rather than a working regime

checks.would_need: a future-mutation test per layer, plus a leaky control that IS detected
checks.note: a suite that can never fail proves nothing, so the leaky control must be caught

checks.would_need: a window never used for design, and presets that were not full-sample tuned
checks.note: the outer window is declared NOT an untouched holdout: the supplied presets were TPE-tuned on the full sample with an unknown cutoff

contamination_note.reason: supplied presets were TPE-tuned on the full sample and the tuning cutoff is unknown, so no interval of this dataset can be called an untouched holdout

checks.would_need: every reported dimension moving the same way, not one
checks.verdict: no separation: B better in 9 cells, A better in 6, sign-test p=0.60723876953125. The neighborhood selector is not shown to improve stable performance on this ca
blockers: the arms switched parameters at materially different rates, so the contrast mixes selection quality with switching frequency
4 of 15 cells had an arm that never exercised its selector at any cutoff, so part of this contrast compares a fixed seed point against a selector rather than two selectors
checks.note: the measured verdict is NO SEPARATION, which is not a superiority claim

checks.would_need: every bar of the account trace compared, and the missing fill trace disclosed

fill_trace_parity.detail: The rust backend returns an empty fill sequence at every report level tried (standard and full, with and without audit_detail_limit), so a fill-by-fill comparison is not available on this install. The ACCOUNT trace — equity, positions, fees, funding — is compared exactly and matches. Recorded as a blocked capability rather than described as full-trace parity (guide L02.8).

checks.note: equity, positions, fees and funding are compared bar by bar; the rust backend exposes no fill trace and that is disclosed rather than claimed

checks.would_need: a funding series, and a spot inventory or borrow leg
checks.note: funding does not exist in this storage, so every run is a labelled no-funding cohort and no carry claim is available to make

checks.would_need: a complete flow dataset, not an alert feed
checks.note: nothing was acquired, so no flow claim exists to be wrong

checks.would_need: an execution suite per alpha, not a parse
checks.note: A-HASH is NOT_READY_SPECIFIC_BLOCKER and keeps null metrics; a phase that certified all four would be the failure

checks.would_need: measured OS-level write isolation, not a path convention
mechanism: Worker writes outside LAB_ROOT are refused by the kernel (read-only bind mounts) and repla
checks.note: the write refusal is measured against a FAKE protected fixture, never against a production repo, and market execution stays disabled
